answer_1.quote: For each exercise assigned by the teacher, students in the treatment group had access to a chat with GPT‑4... we first ask GPT to generate a step‑by‑step plan on how to carry out the homework.
datasets: English homework exercises from school curriculum
answer_1.outputs: Tutor responses providing explanations, feedback, and step‑by‑step guidance

answer_4.quote: Students were asked every week if the tutor had made some errors in their chats. Of 160 responses, only 16 indicated a problem... we also randomly went over 10% of the conversations and did not find any additional issues.
answer_4.guideline: Students were asked weekly whether the tutor made errors; researchers manually inspected a random sample of conversations for problematic utterances.
